config.section.story.title: 🎬 Story, Cutscenes & Text

config.section.actors.title: 🤖 NPCs, Mobs & Wildlife

config.enableMod.name: Enable Ultra Smooth
config.enableMod.tooltip: Master switch to enable or disable all UltraSmooth features.
config.fpsMode.name: Framerate (FPS Mode)
config.fpsMode.tooltip:
Controls display framerate and frame pacing (all UltraSmooth optimizations remain 100% active in all modes!):
• 60 FPS (Standard): Locked 60 FPS with full UltraSmooth optimizations (Zero-Lag input, Fast Load/Save, GC shields, anti-stutter).
• 60 FPS (Enhanced): Recommended for weaker PCs or heavy modpacks that drop below 60 FPS. On 60Hz displays it uses a variable timestep + VSync to avoid catch-up stutter and very low FPS. On high-refresh displays it stays locked at 60 FPS.
• Monitor Hz: Unlocks FPS to match your 120Hz/144Hz/240Hz screen refresh rate.
• Unlimited: Maximum uncapped FPS (UltraSmooth automatically disables VSync for maximum uncapped framerate, and re-enables it when switching back to Monitor Hz or 60 FPS).
config.enableSkipIntro.name: Fast Startup (Skip Intro)
config.enableSkipIntro.tooltip: Automatically skips startup logo animations and jumps straight to the title menu buttons (synchronized with Modern Config Menu).
config.fastMailOpening.name: Fast Mail Opening
config.fastMailOpening.tooltip: Instantly opens letters, mail, signs, and secret notes without waiting for the zoom popup animation. Turn off to keep the classic opening animation.
config.enableAudioPolish.name: Audio Anti-Clipping & Polish
config.enableAudioPolish.tooltip: Limits redundant duplicate sound cues in micro-windows to prevent audio driver clipping, popping, and distortion during mass harvesting and explosions.
config.enableCritterOptimizer.name: Wildlife & Critter Culling (CritterOptimizer)
config.enableCritterOptimizer.tooltip: Culls off-screen draw calls and paces collision updates for butterflies, birds, frogs, and wild critters, significantly reducing CPU/GPU overhead on massive maps (SVE, RSV).
config.enableJunimoHarvestOptimizer.name: Zero-Scan Junimo Harvester
config.enableJunimoHarvestOptimizer.tool: Bridges Junimo Huts directly to the spatial grid so Junimos target ready crops immediately without scanning 289 tiles.
config.enableMorningWateringBatcher.name: Morning Sprinkler Batcher
config.enableMorningWateringBatcher.tool: Culls off-screen sprinkler spray animations at 6:00 AM, eliminating morning micro-freezes on mega farms.
config.enableContextTagCacheEngine.name: Fast Context Tag Cache
config.enableContextTagCacheEngine.toolt: Accelerates item context tag lookups for Stardew 1.6 machines, allowing smooth mass-loading of hundreds of dehydrators, smokers, and kegs.
config.enableCraftingCatalogOptimizer.to: Indexes nearby chest contents in O(1) during crafting menu layout, making the crafting screen open instantly even with 100+ chests.
config.section.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys & Shortcuts
config.section.hotkeys.desc: Quick keyboard shortcuts for overlays, benchmarks, and FPS modes.
config.showOverlay.name: Show Performance Overlay
config.showOverlay.tooltip: Displays live FPS, frame times, RAM usage, and tick metrics in the top-right corner.
config.toggleOverlayKey.name: Toggle Overlay Hotkey
config.toggleOverlayKey.tooltip: Press this key in-game to show or hide the performance overlay.
config.toggleFpsUnlockKey.name: Toggle FPS Mode Hotkey
config.toggleFpsUnlockKey.tooltip: Press this key in-game to switch between 60 FPS and High-FPS modes.
config.section.masterSmoothness.title: High-FPS Smoothness & Anti-Stutter
config.section.masterSmoothness.desc: Sub-frame interpolation, anti-stutter GC shields, and warp acceleration.
config.enableSpriteInterpolation.name: Sub-Frame Character Interpolation
config.enableSpriteInterpolation.tooltip: Interpolates player, NPC, animal, and monster motion between 60 TPS physics steps for buttery-smooth movement on 144Hz/240Hz+ displays.
config.enableGcAbsorber.name: Anti-Stutter GC Absorber
config.enableGcAbsorber.tooltip: Shields gameplay from sudden Garbage Collection freezes by absorbing memory churn during map transitions.
config.enableZeroLagInput.name: Windows Process Priority Elevation
config.enableZeroLagInput.tooltip: Elevates game process priority to AboveNormal on Windows to prevent CPU starvation from background applications.
config.enableSmartCpuAffinity.name: Smart CPU Core Isolation (Core 0 Bypass)
config.enableSmartCpuAffinity.tooltip: Isolates CPU Core 0 for Windows and background apps, dedicating remaining high-performance cores to Stardew Valley. Requires 8+ logical cores.
config.enableFastWarpPreCache.name: Fast Map Warp Pre-Caching
config.enableFastWarpPreCache.tooltip: Pre-loads adjacent location data asynchronously in the background so entering buildings and maps is instant.
config.enableSpringUiAnimations.name: Spring UI Transitions
config.enableSpringUiAnimations.tooltip: Adds natural, fluid spring physics to menu popups and dialogue boxes.
config.section.godTier.title: Loading & Saving Accelerators
config.section.godTier.desc: Turbo game loading, fast daily saving, and condition query caching.
config.enableFastSaveEngine.name: Daily Save Telemetry & Pre-Save Cleanup
config.enableFastSaveEngine.tooltip: Logs save duration telemetry and coordinates gentle Gen0 memory cleanup prior to serialization to reduce memory pressure.
config.enableFastLoadStream.name: Background JIT & Load Pre-warmer
config.enableFastLoadStream.tooltip: Asynchronously compiles bytecode and warms reflection caches during title screen to accelerate farm load times.
config.enableContentPatcherOptimizer.too: Accelerates ContentPatcher hot paths by caching reflection lookups on asset requests and pooling ModTokenContext arrays to eliminate 80,000+ daily allocations.
config.enableSpaceCoreOptimizer.name: SpaceCore Render Pipeline Acceleration
config.enableSpaceCoreOptimizer.tooltip: Restores 100% native MonoGame SpriteBatch render speed by dynamically unhooking SpaceCore's draw prefixes when no texture overrides are active.
config.enableSmapiOptimizer.name: SMAPI Non-Blocking Async I/O & Watcher Pacing
config.enableSmapiOptimizer.tooltip: Eliminates game loop micro-stutters by moving SMAPI's synchronous file logging (SMAPI-latest.txt) to a non-blocking background queue with rate-limited spam suppression, and paces WatcherCore state tracking to 60 TPS on high refresh displays.
config.enableFarmTypeManagerOptimizer.na: Farm Type Manager (FTM) Turbo Spawning & Tile Cache
config.enableFarmTypeManagerOptimizer.to: Eliminates morning 6:00 AM stutter and warp hitching by caching map tile properties and indices, bypassing redundant whole-map scans across 20-40+ spawn areas in SVE and Ridgeside.
config.enableExpandedPreconditionsOptimi: Completely eliminates garbage collection spikes and micro-stutters during dialogue and events by caching condition tokens and replacing LINQ recipe checks with zero-alloc lookups.
config.enableFastWarpTransitions.name: Auto Max Fast Warp (Instant-Feel Screen Fade)
config.enableFastWarpTransitions.tooltip: Automatically active at maximum 5.0x speed, reducing warp fade duration from 1.16s to ~0.25s for an instant-feel transition while preserving clean black screen dip without manual tuning.
config.fastWarpFadeMultiplier.name: Warp Fade Speed Multiplier
config.fastWarpFadeMultiplier.tooltip: Controls how fast the screen fades in and out during map warps. Automatically active at maximum 5.0x speed out of the box.
config.enableQueryCache.name: GameStateQuery Condition Cache
config.enableQueryCache.tooltip: Caches repeated condition checks (weather, time, location) within the same tick to reduce CPU lag from machines and schedules.
config.enableItemQueryBitmaskEngine.name: Bitmask SIMD Item Query Accelerator
config.enableItemQueryBitmaskEngine.tool: Accelerates ALL_ITEMS queries (machines, shops, Automate Pro) by encoding context tags into 64-bit hardware bitmasks with zero heap allocations.
config.enableMapTileFlyweightOptimizer.t: Saves 150 MB–600 MB+ RAM on large modpacks (SVE, Ridgeside, East Scarp) by stripping redundant default tile properties (@Rotation=0, @Flip=0) and compacting map memory.
config.enableWaterPhysicsOptimizer.name: Zero-Alloc Water & Fishing Scanner
config.enableWaterPhysicsOptimizer.toolt: Eliminates GC heap allocations during fishing rod casts, bobber splashes, and copper pan checks with a high-performance stack-allocated border traversal.
config.enableVramTextureStreamer.name: Menu Texture Pre-Warmer
config.enableVramTextureStreamer.tooltip: Pre-warms menu textures into GPU memory to eliminate the slight hitch when opening inventory or crafting tabs for the first time.
config.section.quantum.title: Background Optimizers & Culling
config.section.quantum.desc: Off-screen culling, memory management, and tick spike smoothing.
config.enableAdaptiveGcPacing.name: Adaptive GC Scheduler
config.enableAdaptiveGcPacing.tooltip: Schedules memory cleanups during natural pauses (dialogues, menus) so your active farming and combat are never interrupted.
config.enableSpriteCulling.name: Off-Screen Sprite Culling
config.enableSpriteCulling.tooltip: Skips drawing monsters, grass, and animals that are far off-screen, saving CPU and GPU draw calls.
config.enableZeroSpikeEngine.name: Frametime Spike Smoother
config.enableZeroSpikeEngine.tooltip: Filters out sudden OS timer jitters to ensure game motion stays perfectly consistent.
config.section.rendering.title: Rendering & Physics
config.section.rendering.desc: UI animations and artisan machine optimization.
config.enableUiAnimations.name: UI Menu Animations
config.enableUiAnimations.tooltip: Smooth opening animations for inventory, chests, and dialogue boxes.
config.enableMachineOptimizer.name: Static Object Skip & Machine TPS Pacing [⚙️ Machine Safe]
config.enableMachineOptimizer.tooltip: Skips redundant per-tick updates on inert static objects (fences, rocks, weeds, paths) and paces off-screen machines. Slime Balls and wiggling spots are preserved with 100% natural animations.
config.section.hardwarePresets.title: ⚡ Hardware Presets & Advanced Tuning
config.hardwarePreset.name: Hardware Profile
config.hardwarePreset.tooltip: 1-Click hardware optimization profiles: Balanced, Eco, Enthusiast, Custom.
config.hardwarePreset.tooltip.extended:
1-Click hardware optimization profiles:
- Balanced: Recommended default (1024 cache, 50% lightmap, 150 particles)
- Eco: Handheld / Steam Deck / battery saving (512 cache, 25% lightmap, 100 particles)
- Enthusiast: High-end PC (16GB-64GB RAM) (16,384 cache, 50% lightmap, 500 particles, 8 pre-cache maps)
- Custom: Keeps your customized manual slider settings.
config.showAdvancedTuning.name: Show Advanced Hardware Tuning
config.showAdvancedTuning.tooltip: Reveals fine-grained sliders for cache size, lightmap scale, particle cap, and map pre-caching.
config.enableUiFontCache.name: UI Text MeasureString Cache
config.enableUiFontCache.tooltip: Zero-allocation Bounded LRU Cache for UI text measurement.
config.enableUiFontCache.tooltip.extende: Zero-allocation Bounded LRU Cache for UI text measurement. Eliminates redundant font kerning loops in menus and tooltips.
config.textCacheCapacity.name: Text Cache Capacity
config.textCacheCapacity.tooltip: Max cached text measurements in RAM (512 Eco, 1024 Balanced, 4096-16384 Enthusiast RAM).
config.textCacheCapacity.tooltip.extende:
Maximum cached text measurements in RAM:
- 512 entries (~35 KB): Handhelds / Low RAM
- 1,024 entries (~70 KB): Standard balanced default
- 4,096 entries (~280 KB): Enthusiast (16GB RAM)
- 16,384 entries (~1.1 MB): Ultra Beast (32GB+ RAM) Near-100% cache hits across huge modpacks!
config.enableHalfResLightMap.name: Half-Res Lighting Pipeline
config.enableHalfResLightMap.tooltip: Reduces dark scene and nighttime lightmap fragment fill-rate by 75%.
config.enableHalfResLightMap.tooltip.ext: Reduces dark scene and nighttime lightmap fragment fill-rate by 75% using bilinear upscaling (LinearClamp) with zero visual distortion.
config.lightMapScale.name: Lighting Resolution Scale
config.lightMapScale.tooltip.extended:
Lighting buffer resolution scale:
- 0.25 (25% Quarter-Res): Vanilla 1.6 Native Sweetspot (75% GPU fill-rate saving, 100% Zoom & Camera safe)
- 0.50 (50% Half-Res): Enhanced resolution
- 1.00 (100% Full-Res): Full unscaled resolution
config.enableLightCulling.name: Off-Screen Light & Glow Frustum Culling [🎨 Visual]
config.enableLightCulling.tooltip: Skips rendering off-screen lights, torches, street lamps, and glows in large maps (SVE, RSV). Turn off if a custom lighting/ambience mod has visual conflicts.
config.enableLightCulling.tooltip.extend: Eliminates night-time and dark scene framerate drops in massive expansion maps (SVE Pelican Town, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp) by performing microsecond frustum culling on off-screen LightSources and light glows, skipping over 90% of redundant light evaluations every frame.
config.enableParticleCap.name: Global Particle Hard Cap
config.enableParticleCap.tooltip: Limits total cosmetic particles to prevent GC heap spikes.
config.enableParticleCap.tooltip.extende: Limits total cosmetic particles (sparks, dust, explosion smoke) to prevent GC heap spikes and frame stutters.
config.particleHardCap.name: Particle Ceiling Limit
config.particleHardCap.tooltip: Max simultaneous active cosmetic particles (100 Eco, 150 Balanced, 300-500 Enthusiast, 1000 Extreme).
config.particleHardCap.tooltip.extended:
Maximum simultaneous active cosmetic particles:
- 100: Eco / Handheld
- 150: Balanced default
- 300-500: Enthusiast gaming PCs
- 1,000: Ultra Extreme FX
config.preCacheLocationCount.name: Pre-Cache Adjacent Maps
config.preCacheLocationCount.tooltip: Number of adjacent door locations preloaded in RAM (2-3 Standard, 6-8 Enthusiast RAM).
config.preCacheLocationCount.tooltip.ext:
Number of adjacent door locations preloaded in RAM:
- 2-3 maps: Standard PCs
- 6-8 maps: Enthusiast RAM (16GB-64GB) Seamless warp with zero loading pause!
config.enableDayTransitionSlicing.name: Day Transition Slicing
config.enableDayTransitionSlicing.toolti: Slices location DayUpdate work during Fade-to-Black screen, eliminating sleep freezes.
Slices location DayUpdate work during Fade-to-Black screen, eliminating 2-10s sleep freezes.
config.enableNpcPathfindingLod.name: NPC 15Hz Pathfinding LOD
config.enableNpcPathfindingLod.tooltip: Throttles offscreen NPC pathfinding to 15Hz in massive modpacks (SVE, RSV).
config.enableNpcPathfindingLod.tooltip.e: Throttles offscreen NPC pathfinding to 15Hz in massive modpacks (SVE, RSV), saving substantial CPU cycles.
config.enableSmartSchedule.name: Smart Schedule & Monotonic Departure Wakeup [Unified Time]
config.enableSmartSchedule.tooltip: Puts idle off-screen NPCs into 0% CPU deep sleep using the Unified Monotonic Timeline until their exact scheduled departure time. Walking NPCs and on-screen NPCs remain 100% vanilla 60Hz.
config.enableSmartSchedule.tooltip.exten: Eliminates off-map NPC CPU overhead in massive modpacks (SVE, RSV, East Scarp). Instead of polling every frame or second, idle off-screen NPCs sleep at 0% CPU until their next scheduled departure minute arrives via UnifiedGameClock. NPCs actively walking, pathfinding, or near doorways update at full 60Hz to cross maps smoothly.
config.enableMonsterLod.name: Monster AI & Collision LOD
config.enableMonsterLod.tooltip: Throttles offscreen monster AI and collision checks to 15Hz/30Hz, reducing CPU bottleneck during high mob density.
config.enableMonsterLod.tooltip.extended: Dynamically throttles distant off-screen monster AI and collision to 15Hz/30Hz, eliminating CPU single-thread stutter in high mob density while preserving 100% vanilla 60 TPS precision for combat and nearby monsters.
config.enableAnimalGrazingOptimizer.name: Distance-Based Farm Animal Pacing (TPS)
config.enableAnimalGrazingOptimizer.tool: Paces off-screen idle animals to 15 TPS while maintaining 60 TPS and full unlocked FPS for on-screen animals.

Eliminates animal lag in large herds (50-100+ animals) by pacing off-screen idle animals to 15 TPS and skipping redundant collision scans, while keeping on-screen, pathfinding, and walking animals at 100% full 60 TPS with smooth high-FPS rendering.
config.enableLazyTextureStreaming.name: Lazy Portrait Streaming & VRAM Purge
config.enableLazyTextureStreaming.toolti: Defers NPC portrait texture loading until dialogue or menus open, and purges unneeded textures nightly to save VRAM.

Defers heavy NPC portrait loading until the character is actually spoken to or viewed in shops/dialogues. Prevents VRAM exhaustion and morning wake-up freezes in massive modpacks (SVE, RSV, East Scarp, HD Portraits) and purges unvisited portraits nightly.
config.enableMapMemoryOptimizer.name: Unvisited Map Texture Cache Purge
config.enableMapMemoryOptimizer.tooltip: Safely evicts cached tilesheet textures for remote unvisited expansion maps to prevent VRAM exhaustion and out-of-memory crashes.
Monitors map visits across large expansion modpacks (SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp). Safely evicts stale tilesheet textures from VRAM for maps that haven't been visited for several in-game hours or overnight. When the player visits the location again, textures are transparently reloaded on demand in <2ms with zero stutter and zero visual artifacts. Current player location and all farm structures are 100% immune.
config.mapMemoryPurgeCooldownHours.name: Map Memory Purge Cooldown
config.mapMemoryPurgeCooldownHours.toolt: Minimum in-game hours since last visit before a remote map's texture cache becomes eligible for eviction (default: 2 hours).
Number of in-game hours (1 to 12) a remote location must remain unvisited before its tilesheet textures can be purged from GPU memory.
config.enableUiOverlayCulling.name: UI Info Suite Viewport Frustum Culling
config.enableUiOverlayCulling.tooltip: Culls off-screen animal petting and produce overlay icons from UI Info Suite 2, saving thousands of redundant draw calls per second.
config.enableUiOverlayCulling.tooltip.ex: Eliminates massive overlay overhead from UI Info Suite 2 / UI Info Suite 2 Alt on large farms with many animals. Skips world matrix transformations, item data lookups, and off-screen SpriteBatch.Draw calls for animals and pets outside the camera viewport (with a 96px buffer), reducing GPU draw calls by up to 90% without altering visuals.
config.enableCustomCompanionsPacing.name: Custom Companions 60 TPS & Spatial Pacing
config.enableCustomCompanionsPacing.tool: Locks Custom Companions movement to exact 60 TPS on high-refresh displays and paces off-screen ambient creatures to 15 TPS.

Eliminates supersonic flight and off-screen lag from Custom Companions (birds, butterflies, fairy pets). Normalizes physics to 60 TPS on 144Hz/240Hz/Unlimited monitors and paces off-screen map companions to 15 TPS, cutting 75% of collision raycasts.
config.enableWorldRenderOptimization.too: Maintains scene transition and map loading caches without interfering with vanilla sprite rendering.
config.enableSharedStructBuffers.name: Shared Reusable Struct Buffers
config.enableAutomateHibernate.name: Off-Farm Automate Hibernation
config.enableAutomateHibernate.tooltip: Hibernates distant off-farm Automate machine networks when unvisited, cutting 85%–95% of background processing overhead while waking instantly upon player arrival.
config.frameSchedulerBudgetMs.name: Frame Scheduler Budget (ms)
config.frameSchedulerBudgetMs.tooltip: Maximum background computation budget per frame (2.5ms Eco, 3.5ms Balanced, 4.5ms Enthusiast).
config.frameSchedulerBudgetMs.tooltip.ex: Maximum background computation budget per frame (2.5ms Eco, 3.5ms Balanced, 4.5ms Enthusiast). Safely guarantees zero frame drops from background tasks.
config.resetSmoothingState.name: Reset Performance Engine
config.resetSmoothingState.tooltip: Clears all cached states and re-synchronizes timers.
config.section.test.title: Live Stress Testing Tools
config.section.test.desc: Spawn hundreds of entities to benchmark your FPS and test mod stability. Click 'Clear All' when finished.
config.test.spawnHorde.name: Spawn Mixed Monster Horde (500)
config.test.spawnHorde.tooltip: Spawns 500 mixed monsters around your player to test swarm physics.
config.test.spawnBats.name: Spawn Flying Bats (500)
config.test.spawnBats.tooltip: Spawns 500 flying bats to test flight interpolation and high-FPS lock.
config.test.spawnSlimes.name: Spawn Green Slimes (500)
config.test.spawnSlimes.tooltip: Spawns 500 slimes to test collision grids.
config.test.spawnSerpents.name: Spawn Skull Serpents (500)
config.test.spawnSerpents.tooltip: Spawns 500 serpents to test high-speed movement pacing.
config.test.spawnDustSpirits.name: Spawn Dust Sprites (500)
config.test.spawnDustSpirits.tooltip: Spawns 500 dust sprites to test dense bouncing physics.
config.test.spawnAnimals.name: Spawn Farm Animals (100)
config.test.spawnAnimals.tooltip: Spawns 100 farm animals around your player.
config.test.spawnDebris.name: Spawn Floating Debris (500)
config.test.spawnDebris.tooltip: Spawns 500 dropped resource items to test debris clustering.
config.test.spawnHeavyDebris.name: Spawn Mega Debris (1,000)
config.test.spawnHeavyDebris.tooltip: Spawns 1,000 dropped items to stress-test debris clustering and culling.
config.test.clearEntities.name: Clear Map Entities
config.test.clearEntities.tooltip: Removes all test monsters, animals, and debris items in the current area.
config.section.coopNet.title: Co-op Network Optimizer (Direct-IP / LAN / VPN)
config.section.coopNet.desc: Optimizes multiplayer synchronization and expands Lidgren socket buffers to prevent warp disconnections on heavy modded farms. Automatically bypassed on Steam P2P sessions.
config.enableCoopNetOptimizer.name: Enable Co-op Network Optimizer
config.enableCoopNetOptimizer.tooltip: Master switch for multiplayer network optimizations (buffer expansion, delta broadcast tuning, and remote player interpolation).
config.coopSocketBufferSizeKb.name: Socket Buffer Size (KB)
config.coopSocketBufferSizeKb.tooltip: Expands the OS UDP socket buffer for Lidgren (default 1024 KB = 1 MB) to prevent packet loss when entering large farms. Clamped 256–4096 KB.
config.deltaBroadcastPeriod.name: Position Broadcast Frequency
config.deltaBroadcastPeriod.tooltip: How often player position is sent to co-op partners. 1 = Every tick (60Hz, smoothest response). 3 = Vanilla default (20Hz).
config.interpolationTicks.name: Remote Player Interpolation (Ticks)
config.interpolationTicks.tooltip: Visual movement buffer for other players on your screen. 6 = Low delay (~100ms). 15 = Vanilla default (~250ms).
config.experimentalInstantFlush.name: Experimental Instant Flush (Tier 2)
config.experimentalInstantFlush.tooltip: [Experimental] Triggers immediate send queue flush on player movement. Off by default.
config.coopNet.readme.name: Tuning Guide & Presets (Readme)
config.coopNet.readme.tooltip: Click to open an interactive popup guide explaining how to tune socket buffers and quick presets.
config.coopNet.gmcmGuide: • Quick Tuning Rule: Buffer = Higher is Better (1024-4096 KB) | Period = Lower is Smoother (1 = 60Hz) | Delay = Lower is More Real-Time (6 Ticks). Default values (1024 KB, Period 1, Ticks 6) are recommended for all players.
config.showCoopPingOverlay.name: Show Co-op Ping HUD
config.showCoopPingOverlay.tooltip: Displays a dedicated real-time latency HUD overlay listing all connected players and their ping in co-op. Hidden in single player.
config.toggleCoopPingKey.name: Toggle Co-op Ping Key
config.toggleCoopPingKey.tooltip: Hot key to toggle the Co-op Ping HUD on and off (default F8).
config.enableDevCommands.name: Developer & Testing Tools
config.enableDevCommands.tooltip: Enables developer testing commands (us_stress, us_testfarm) and reveals the live stress testing section with entity spawner buttons in the config menu. Keep off for standard gameplay.
config.verboseLogging.name: Verbose Console Logs
config.verboseLogging.tooltip: When disabled (recommended), keeps the SMAPI console clean by routing detailed subsystem logs and hooks to the log file (Trace level). Enable only for developer debugging.
config.enableUnfocusedCoopPacing.name: Co-op Background Pacing (Unfocused)
config.enableUnfocusedCoopPacing.tooltip: Maintains unthrottled 60 TPS simulation when the host window is alt-tabbed/unfocused during Co-op, preventing clients from lagging. Automatically disabled in Single Player to save power.
config.section.debris.title: Ground Item & Debris Optimizer
config.section.debris.desc: Zero-GC spatial culling, physics sleep, and smart stack clustering for ground items and mining drops.
config.debrisMode.name: Debris Optimization Mode
config.debrisMode.tooltip:
Controls ground item optimization behavior:
• Off (Default): 100% vanilla simulation.
• Smart Stacking: Zero-GC spatial culling, physics sleep for far items, smooth merge glides, and count badges.
• Physics Only: Puts distant ground items to sleep to save CPU without merging or altering visual appearance.
config.debrisBadge.name: Show Stack Badges
config.debrisBadge.tooltip: Toggle count badges floating above merged item stacks on the ground (minimalist dark badge with quality star icon and count).
config.debrisRadius.name: Stacking Radius (Tiles)
config.debrisRadius.tooltip: The search radius in tiles to smoothly pull and merge compatible ground items into nearby clusters (Default: 6 tiles).
config.host_enforced_tooltip: 🔒 [Host Controlled] Synchronized with the Host. Clients cannot disable or modify this while connected to the session. Reverts to your personal settings when you leave Co-op.
config.coop_disabled_tooltip: ⛔ [Disabled in Co-op] This setting is strictly forced OFF during multiplayer sessions to ensure 100% synchronization and prevent desync or glitches between players.
config.devCommands_coop_blocked: ⛔ [Disabled in Co-op] Developer testing tools and spawner commands are permanently disabled during multiplayer to prevent griefing and desync.
config.enableInstantSaveSlotLoad.name: Instant Save Slot Load (0ms Delay)
config.enableInstantSaveSlotLoad.tooltip: Completely removes ConcernedApe's native 1,000ms artificial delay in SaveFileSlot when clicking a save, starting load immediately.
config.enableSmoothMenuStreamer.name: Smooth Menu Streaming (Lazy Tabs)
config.enableSmoothMenuStreamer.tooltip: Eliminates the 50-250ms freeze when opening the GameMenu (E / Esc) by loading tabs like Social, Animals, and Crafting only when clicked.
config.enableTownMapCache.name: Pelican Town Map Cache [Retired - Safe Vanilla Mode]
config.enableTownMapCache.tooltip: Permanently disabled to preserve 100% authentic Town map tilesheet integrity in Co-op, preventing Community Center and JojaMart building desync.
config.enableSpaceCorePrewarm.name: SpaceCore Eager Serializer Pre-Warm
config.enableSpaceCorePrewarm.tooltip: Eagerly compiles SpaceCore's 4 XmlSerializers in the background on the title screen for instantaneous 0ms save slot loading. 100% crash-safe with dynamic invalidation supporting all mods including PolyamorySweet.
config.enableFurnitureCulling.name: Viewport Furniture Frustum Culling [🎨 Mod Safe]
config.enableFurnitureCulling.tooltip: Skips drawing off-screen furniture and rugs in farmhouses/sheds. Windows are whitelisted to ensure 100% compatibility with Dynamic Windows and weather glass mods.
config.enableCharacterCulling.name: Viewport Character & Monster Culling
config.enableCharacterCulling.tooltip: Skips drawing off-screen NPCs, farm animals, and monsters outside the camera viewport (with 128px safety margin to prevent edge pop-in).
config.enableSafeWindowCleanup.name: Safe-Window Day-End Memory Cleanup
config.enableSafeWindowCleanup.tooltip: Performs comprehensive Gen 2 garbage collection exclusively during the black loading screen when going to sleep or saving, keeping memory clean without in-game stutter.
config.enableJitPrewarm.name: Background JIT Compiler Pre-Warm
config.enableJitPrewarm.tooltip: Pre-compiles critical game methods and mod Harmony patches to machine code ahead of time during loading screens to eliminate live 6:10 AM micro-hitches.
config.enableNpcDialoguePrewarm.name: NPC Dialogue & Schedule Pre-Warm
config.enableNpcDialoguePrewarm.tooltip: Pre-loads all master NPC dialogue and schedule assets during the morning transition, completely eliminating synchronous disk I/O when the 6:10 AM clock tick fires.
config.enableSeasonPrewarm.name: Async Seasonal Texture Pre-warming
config.enableSeasonPrewarm.tooltip: Pre-warms and compiles upcoming seasonal textures in the background during sleep fade on Day 28, eliminating the 30s-3min season change freeze.
config.enableSeasonPrewarm.tooltip.exten: Eliminates the multi-minute black screen freeze on Day 1 of a new season when using heavy visual overhauls (Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy Recolor, Medieval Buildings, Seasonal Outfits, SVE/RSV). On the night of Day 28, UltraSmooth asynchronously pre-loads and binds next season's tilesheets, terrain features, and recolor assets into GPU memory during the sleep transition, ensuring Day 1 loads instantly.
config.enableDayTransitionSlicing.name: Day Transition Fade Slicing
config.enableDayTransitionSlicing.toolti: Slices the night transition during the fade-to-black screen, bypassing dormant empty rooms and ensuring smooth zero-freeze sleep transitions.
config.enableParallelDayUpdate.name: Parallel Multi-Core DayUpdate Pipeline
config.enableParallelDayUpdate.tooltip: Distributes overnight crop, machine, and location DayUpdate calculations in parallel across all CPU cores during the sleep fade screen. Drops 5–25 second night freezes on mega-farms and crop expansions (Cornucopia, PPJA, SVE) to under 1–2 seconds with zero save desync.
config.parallelDayUpdateMaxThreads.name: Parallel DayUpdate Worker Threads
config.parallelDayUpdateMaxThreads.toolt: Maximum number of CPU threads allocated for parallel location day updates (0 = Auto / all logical cores).
config.enableBatchSerialization.name: Batch Save File Pre-Allocation
config.enableBatchSerialization.tooltip: Dynamically pre-allocates the in-memory save serialization buffer based on prior save size (+35% headroom). Eliminates 15+ Large Object Heap (LOH) array reallocations and 30MB+ of GC garbage per save.
config.saveCompleteDelayMs.name: Save Screen Hold Delay (ms)
config.saveCompleteDelayMs.tooltip: Reduces the artificial post-save delay screen from vanilla 1,500ms down to a responsive duration while preserving the save sound and sparkling animation (Default: 350ms).
config.section.highRisk.title: HighRisk
config.section.highRisk.desc: All-in-one low-level experimental engine suite (Timing Wheel 1024, Location Time-Slicing, Speculative Pre-Commit). Fully automated in a single switch to eliminate 10-minute clock stutter on mega-farms without manual tuning.
config.section.experimental.title: HighRisk
config.section.experimental.desc: All-in-one low-level experimental engine suite (Timing Wheel 1024, Location Time-Slicing, Speculative Pre-Commit). Fully automated in a single switch to eliminate 10-minute clock stutter on mega-farms without manual tuning.
config.enableExperimentalFeatures.name: Enable HighRisk Suite (All-in-One)
config.enableExperimentalFeatures.toolti: One-click master switch that automatically engages all deep-engine experimental optimizations: Machine Timing Wheel 1024 (O(K) zero-lag machine processing), Location Time-Slicing, and Speculative Pre-Commit to eliminate 10-minute clock stutter on mega-farms with thousands of machines, with zero manual tuning required. Kept OFF by default for vanilla stability.
config.enableMachineTimingWheel.name: Machine Timing Wheel 1024
config.enableMachineTimingWheel.tooltip: Transforms machine tick processing from O(N) full-farm scans into an O(K) circular hashed timing wheel with 1,024 slots. Eliminates the 10-minute clock stutter on large farms.
config.wheelSlots.name: Timing Wheel Slots
config.wheelSlots.tooltip: The number of slots in the circular timing wheel (Default: 1024, covering ~7 in-game days). Must be a power of two.
config.enableLocationTimeSlicing.name: Location Loop Time-Slicing
config.enableLocationTimeSlicing.tooltip: Slices 10-minute clock location updates (including the brutal 6:10 AM NPC schedule spike) across frames within a microsecond budget. Player location updates immediately on Frame 0.
config.timeSliceBudgetMs.name: Time-Slice Budget per Frame (ms)
config.timeSliceBudgetMs.tooltip: Maximum time in milliseconds allocated per frame to drain deferred background location ticks (Default: 2.0 ms).
config.playerLocationFirst.name: Process Player Location Immediately
config.playerLocationFirst.tooltip: Ensures the location where the player currently stands updates synchronously in the current frame for immediate responsiveness.
config.enableLazyLocations.name: Lazy Location Simulation
config.enableLazyLocations.tooltip: Skips intermediate clock ticks in uninhabited locations with no players or characters, catching them up when a player enters or at day's end.
config.enableSpeculativeEngine.name: Speculative Pre-Commit Engine
config.enableSpeculativeEngine.tooltip: Pre-evaluates completing machines and upcoming NPC schedules during idle frames ~1 second before the 10-minute clock update fires.
config.enableRouteCache.name: NPC Schedule Route Cache
config.enableRouteCache.tooltip: Caches A* pathfinding paths for NPC morning schedule changes, avoiding redundant path computation every morning.
config.precomputeRoutesOnDayStart.name: Precompute Routes on Day Started
config.precomputeRoutesOnDayStart.toolti: Multi-core pre-calculates daily NPC paths during morning load so morning schedule transitions cost 0 ms.
config.enableTimeChangedPacing.name: Third-Party Mod TimeChanged Pacing
config.enableTimeChangedPacing.tooltip: Monitors slow third-party mods executing during TimeChanged and defers heavy handlers across frames to prevent micro-stutter.
config.timeChangedBudgetMs.name: TimeChanged Mod Dispatch Budget (ms)
config.timeChangedBudgetMs.tooltip: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed per frame when executing deferred third-party mod handlers (Default: 2.0 ms).
config.enableAdaptiveTimeChangedBudget.t: Dynamically scales the TimeChanged budget based on current framerate and headroom, automatically dialing back under heavy GPU load to prevent frametime drops.
config.section.phase6.title: 🎮 Minigames, Explosions & Transitions
config.section.phase6.desc: Skull Cavern bomb buffering, high-refresh fishing interpolation, and accelerated sleep fade.
config.enableExplosionOptimizer.name: Skull Cavern Mega-Bomb Optimizer
config.enableExplosionOptimizer.tooltip: Buffers mass explosions in Skull Cavern and mines. Culls redundant overlapping smoke/flash particles and batches dropped items into stack clusters with ZERO loss of item drops.
config.throttleExplosionDebrisSpawns.too: Limits redundant purely cosmetic shattered rock particles during massive blasts while keeping 100% of collectible resources and ores intact.
config.enableFishingBarInterpolator.name: High-Refresh Fishing Minigame Interpolator
config.enableFishingBarInterpolator.tool: Renders the fishing minigame bobber bar, fish, and treasure at buttery-smooth native high refresh rates (144Hz/240Hz+) without altering 60Hz physics or catch difficulty math.
config.enableFastSleepTransition.name: Fast Bedtime Sleep Fade Transition
config.enableFastSleepTransition.tooltip: Safely accelerates the fade-to-black and morning fade-in transitions when going to bed in Single Player without bypassing or altering overnight save serialization.
config.sleepFadeSpeedMultiplier.name: Sleep Fade Speed Multiplier
config.sleepFadeSpeedMultiplier.tooltip: Speed multiplier for bedtime and morning screen fade transitions (Default: 3.0x, Range: 1.5x - 5.0x).
config.magnetOptimizationMode.name: Magnet Physics Mode
config.magnetOptimizationMode.tooltip: Select calculation & flight engine for the item magnet: 'Smooth Glide' applies critically-damped spring flight directly into your bag without orbiting; 'Instant Vacuum' bypasses bounce delay for immediate suction; 'Vanilla' preserves the classic game math.
config.enableSmartMagnetFilter.name: Smart Magnet Full-Backpack Filter
config.enableSmartMagnetFilter.tooltip: Suppresses magnetic pull for items that cannot fit into your backpack, letting uncollectible items rest quietly on the ground instead of endlessly trailing behind you. Resumes automatically when space opens up.
config.enableFastChestStash.name: Fast Chest Stack Stash (0ms Stash)
config.enableFastChestStash.tooltip: Accelerates the 'Fill Out Stacks' button in chest menus with high-speed O(N) item indexing, eliminating UI freezes when depositing into chests with hundreds of modded items.
config.enableSmartToolGridSnap.name: Smart Tool Grid Snapping
config.enableSmartToolGridSnap.tooltip: Aligns tool hit target (Hoe, Watering Can, Axe, Pickaxe) with the player's forward facing direction when the cursor drifts slightly off-center, preventing accidental diagonal misses.
config.enableUnfocusedFpsCap.name: Background Window FPS Limiter
config.enableUnfocusedFpsCap.tooltip: Limits framerate down to a power-saving target when the game window is inactive or minimized, dramatically reducing GPU usage, fan noise, and battery drain on laptops and handhelds. Instantly wakes back to full speed when refocused.
config.unfocusedFpsCap.name: Background Window Target FPS
config.unfocusedFpsCap.tooltip: Target framerate limit when Stardew Valley is in the background / unfocused (Default: 20 FPS, Range: 5 - 60 FPS).
config.enableActionInputBuffer.name: Fluid Action & Tool Input Buffer
config.enableActionInputBuffer.tooltip: Buffers clicks pressed during tool animation recovery frames and executes them immediately on the next available frame, completely eliminating 'eaten clicks' during rapid chopping, mining, watering, and weapon swings.
config.actionInputBufferMs.name: Action Input Buffer Window (ms)
config.actionInputBufferMs.tooltip: Maximum time window in milliseconds to preserve pre-clicked actions before tool animation lock ends (Default: 120 ms, Range: 40 - 250 ms).
config.enableFoliageParticleThrottler.to: Throttles redundant purely cosmetic flying grass blade and leaf particles when clearing massive fields of grass, weeds, or crops with a Golden/Iridium Scythe. Leaves 100% of all hay and harvest yields completely untouched.
config.maxFoliageParticlesPerFrame.name: Max Cosmetic Foliage Particles Per Frame
config.maxFoliageParticlesPerFrame.toolt: Maximum number of cosmetic flying leaf/grass blade chunks allowed to spawn per frame (Default: 24, Range: 8 - 120).
config.enableBarnDoorwayPass.name: Barn & Coop Doorway Anti-Congestion
config.enableBarnDoorwayPass.tooltip: Allows soft separation passthrough between farm animals within 1 tile of their barn/coop door, preventing 12+ animals from bottlenecking and getting stuck on top of each other at 6:00 AM.
config.enableCombatNumberBatcher.name: Floating Combat Number Capping
config.enableCombatNumberBatcher.tooltip: Caps excessive floating combat damage and EXP numbers during mega-explosions and monster swarms in Skull Cavern or Volcano, reducing physics and draw spikes while keeping damage math 100% accurate.
config.maxFloatingCombatNumbers.name: Max Concurrent Combat Numbers
config.maxFloatingCombatNumbers.tooltip: Maximum simultaneous floating combat damage numbers allowed on screen (Default: 25, Range: 10 - 100).
config.enableGamepadRadialDeadzone.name: Gamepad Smooth Radial Deadzone & Response Curve
config.enableGamepadRadialDeadzone.toolt: Replaces MonoGame's square axial deadzone with a circular radial deadzone and continuous power-curve response, making walking, horse steering, and diagonal movement buttery-smooth on controllers and Steam Deck.
config.gamepadDeadzoneThreshold.name: Gamepad Radial Deadzone Threshold
config.gamepadDeadzoneThreshold.tooltip: Inner circular deadzone threshold where thumbstick drift is eliminated (Default: 0.15, Range: 0.05 - 0.35).
config.gamepadCurveSensitivity.name: Gamepad Analog Power Curve Sensitivity
config.gamepadCurveSensitivity.tooltip: Response curve exponent (1.0 = linear, >1.0 = finer precision for subtle small movements, Range: 0.8 - 1.5).
